responsibility: This file builds and manages the front end’s catalog of intrinsic functions, subroutines, and conversion procedures used during name resolution. It owns the intrinsic namespace and current-intrinsic checking context, creates resolved intrinsic symbols and ABI-specific conversion names, classifies intrinsics by purity/elementality, performs intrinsic-specific standard and TS29113 checks, converts expressions to intrinsic conversion calls when needed, and warns about user procedures shadowing standard intrinsics.
same_name_distinction: Implements intrinsic-procedure catalog construction and intrinsic-specific resolution support, including creation of resolved intrinsic symbols, conversion naming, standard checks, and shadowing warnings. Unlike gcc/fortran/intrinsic.h and gcc/fortran/intrinsic.texi, it is executable compiler logic rather than declarations or user reference text.
